manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Lift the smooth plastic tabletrashbin and empty it.

Task description: Lift the smooth white plastic desktop trash bin at the front left of the image and pour its contents into the large trash bin to the left of the table.

Success criteria: Hold the small trash can high, clearly above the table. All five red balls of trash inside must be dumped into the large trash can on the left, landing near its bottom.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the small bin's straight rim facing the robot, avoiding rounded corners, with one finger inside and one against the outer wall. Contact below the flange to reduce slipping from an edge-only grasp.
- Match the gripper opening to the wall thickness and surrounding clearance. Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite sides of the bucket wall; during a small test lift, observe whether the body slips and adjust the grasp if needed.
- Keep the bin opening facing up during transport, leaving clearance between its bottom and the table edge and large bin rim, avoiding an early spill or getting the bin body caught on an edge.
- Position the small bucket's pouring rim above the large bin opening's interior, leaving space for bucket and gripper rotation, then slowly increase tilt to reduce edge collisions and waste falling outside.
- If trash remains in a small-bucket corner, gently oscillate while maintaining a reliable grasp and directing the opening inside the large bin. Check for remaining trash, avoiding violent shaking that could cause slipping or bounce-out.
